plain: A written statement vouching for someone's character or for a fact

webster.text: A writing or certificate in favor of one's character or good conduct.

example.quote: And on this head, we have caused to be made for them letters testimonial patent of the lord Stephen, archbishop of Canterbury, of the lord Henry, archbishop of Dublin, of the bishops aforesaid, and of Master Pandulf as touching this security and the concessions aforesaid.
